purpose: Directory of established marketplaces and official job-search entry points. These are SOURCES, not individually verified live job offers.

owner_contact.note: This link opens a user-initiated WhatsApp chat. It does not send messages automatically.

sources.name: Upwork
sources.how_to_start: Create a complete profile, search by skill, review client history and payment verification, and submit a tailored proposal.
sources.payment_safety: Keep contracts and payments inside the platform's approved workflow; do not pay a client to unlock a job.
sources.verification: Check the live listing, client history, scope, budget, milestones, and platform payment protection before applying.

sources.name: Fiverr
sources.how_to_start: Publish a clear service package with scope, delivery time, exclusions, and examples.
sources.payment_safety: Use Fiverr's official order and payment system; ignore requests to move payment off-platform.
sources.verification: Review current seller rules and publish only services you can deliver.

sources.name: Contra
sources.how_to_start: Build a focused portfolio and service profile, then use the platform's current discovery and project features.
sources.payment_safety: Confirm scope, payment terms, and platform protections before starting.
sources.verification: Check current project details and terms; availability varies.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.how_to_start: Search Remote plus the target skill; check the employer's official company page and apply through a trusted route.
sources.payment_safety: Never pay application, training, equipment-release, or registration fees to a supposed employer.
sources.verification: Confirm the employer domain, role details, recruiter identity, and official application page.

sources.name: Freelancer.com
sources.how_to_start: Search specific deliverables, compare the client's history, and submit a scoped bid.
sources.payment_safety: Use official milestones and dispute tools; never pay a client to receive work.
sources.verification: Validate the listing, budget, client history, requirements, and milestone terms.

sources.name: PeoplePerHour
sources.how_to_start: Create a profile and review currently available projects and offer rules.
sources.payment_safety: Use the platform's official proposal, escrow, and payment processes where available.
sources.verification: Availability and eligibility vary; confirm current platform terms.

anti_scam_rules: No guaranteed income, guaranteed hiring, or guaranteed response is claimed by this directory.
Do not pay registration, security deposit, training, software activation, or withdrawal fees to get a job.
Do not share OTPs, passwords, full card details, or remote-access control with recruiters.
Do not do large unpaid test projects; agree on a small, clearly scoped paid trial instead.
Verify each listing on the platform or employer's official website before applying.
Do not scrape, spam, or automatically message employers or applicants on WhatsApp.

whatsapp_workflow.message_template: Namaste, I am looking for legitimate freelance work in WordPress website development, website maintenance, SEO/blog writing, copywriting, and social media content. Please share the official listing or employer page, scope, budget, deadline, and payment terms. I will verify the opportunity before proceeding.
